title: R' Shimon son of R' Simon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Midrash Tehillim 25:2, but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be “R' Simon in the name of R' Shimon Chasida,” as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The whole OYW Midrash Tehillim 25:2 scalar has abbreviated R' Shimon in the name of fully written Rabbi Simon. Hyman instead says the supplied filiation should read R' Simon in the name of R' Shimon Chasida. These are different directions and forms. His scribal-error judgment and “should read” retain their force and attribution; they are not adopted as a repair. Full titles are not transferred from a transmission clause into the proposed filiation or reversed chain, so the heading and uncollated proposed personal titles remain R'.
